1. Copy a video link from Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, etc.
2. Open RKDownloader and paste it, or use the auto-detect pop-up.
3. Tap Download, select your quality, and the video will download.
4. Alternatively, use the Browser tab to search, navigate to any site, play the video, and click the download button.
